notable.title: Chainalysis Discloses Internal Breach and Customer Data Exposure
Brazilian Court Sanctions Lawyers for Prompt Injection in Filing
Northflank security breach leads to unauthorized use of AI API keys
Claude Code extension poisoned with persistent SSH backdoor
Vapor Panda uses agentic AI pentesting tool in multi-target campaign

narrative.headline: Chainalysis breach and Claude Code extension poisoning highlight AI supply chain attacks
narrative.text: The week had 52 incidents, down 19 from 71, including 10 real-world incidents, down 13 from 23. Notable incidents included blockchain analysis firm Chainalysis suffering a security breach where an external actor accessed non-sensitive customer data using agentic techniques. In Brazil, lawyers were sanctioned after inserting hidden text into a court document to manipulate an AI system. Cloud hosting platform Northflank had stored secrets accessed, leading to unauthorized use of AI API keys. Additionally, a tampered build of Anthropic’s Claude Code extension planted an SSH backdoor on developers’ machines, and a China-backed threat group compromised targets using an agentic AI pentesting tool. A crypto-mining campaign also returned to Hugging Face by distributing backdoored models, while infostealer malware targeted developer keyrings and AI assistant sessions. The busiest family was Prompt injection & jailbreaks with 13 occurrences, and the most-listed targets were Framework / tooling, Open-weight model, and Enterprise deployment. The week also had 42 disclosed vulnerabilities, down 1 from 43.
